name: obsidian-mind
description: A self-organizing Obsidian vault that gives AI coding agents persistent memory.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: r goals (the ShardMind wizard does this for you).
capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: /scripts/ and the commands in .claude/commands/ are agent-agnostic — pure Markdown, TypeScript, and shell with no SDK dependencies.
capability_evidence.skills-plugins: A custom skill in .claude/skills/qmd/ that teaches the agent to use QMD semantic search proactively — before reading files, before creating notes (to check for duplicates), and after creating notes (to find related
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: erything still works — the agent falls back to grep and the Obsidian CLI, and the MCP server entry is skipped with a harmless warning.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: en the conversation touches a listed topic.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor
